d: Jet black, chin-length hair with choppy layers and long bangs that partially obscure the face. Sharp, glowing crimson eyes with a menacing expression, set on a youthful face with the maturity of a late teenager. A lean, slender build wearing a white button-down shirt left open at the chest, a black blazer draped over the shoulders, a black belt, and slim-fit black trousers with a white bandage wrapped around the right thigh. Signature details include a black choker, a dark purple glove on the left hand emitting purple energy, and several long, thin black cables looping around the body.
